annotations.title: Public prices for a corridor, each with a Rate Receipt

description: Read public prices for a corridor at a payment size: on-chain pools, public order books and public adverts, with no partner key. Each figure is a route option with a Rate Receipt (schema swapeazi.rate_receipt.v1): publisher, source_type, read_at, size_priced, rate, official_rate, cost_pct, confidence, evidence_ref and status (proven, priced_only or no_live_route). max_age_seconds says when to read again. A missing figure is null with a reason. Free callers see Route A, Route B; a router key sees source names. Never executes.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

amount.description: Amount in the source currency. Default 10000.

corridor.description: Instead of from and to: USDT-ZAR.
